description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref: 2025/02344/FUL granted 15th December 2025 for the 'Erection of a rear roof extension; erection of a rear extension at second floor level over part of the existing back addition; erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side and rear of the existing back addition; installation of 3no rooflights in the front roofslope and 1no rooflight above the main flat roof at roof level; erection of obscure glazed screens in connection with the formation of a roof terrace at third floor level to the rear elevation, on top of the proposed second floor rear back addition; alterations to the roof of ground floor rear back addition; de-conversion of the existing building from 3no self-contained flats into a single family dwellinghouse' to allow amendments to the approved drawings to include: omission of the roof terrace at third floor level, replacement of the French doors with a window in the rear roofslope, alterations to the design of the rooflights in the front roofslope and installation of one additional rooflight, alterations to the design of the rooflights above the main flat roof and above the roof of ground floor rear back addition, alterations to the design of windows to the rear fenestration of the main building and alterations to the design of the ground floor doors to the rear elevation.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - AMEND CONDITION 2 OF PARENT PERMISSION REF 2025/02344/FUL TO READ:
